title: Overtime limit
steps: Agree a limit on overtime for new hires in the first three months and check it each week.

draft_notes.en: There is now a limit on overtime for new hires in the first three months, checked each week.
draft_notes.ms: Kini ada had kerja lebih masa untuk pekerja baharu dalam tiga bulan pertama, disemak setiap minggu.
draft_notes.zh: 现在新员工在头三个月的加班有上限，并且每周检查。

title: Short weekly one-to-one
steps: Book a fifteen-minute one-to-one each week for the first three months, with one question: what is blocking you?

notes.en: Your team lead now books a short one-to-one with you every week.
notes.ms: Ketua pasukan anda kini mengadakan perjumpaan empat mata yang singkat dengan anda setiap minggu.
notes.zh: 你的组长现在每周都会和你进行一次简短的一对一谈话。

title: Team lunch
steps: Invite the new hire to eat with the team in the first two weeks and introduce them to each person by name.

notes.en: Your team now invites new hires to lunch in the first two weeks and introduces everyone by name.
notes.ms: Pasukan anda kini menjemput pekerja baharu makan tengah hari dalam dua minggu pertama dan memperkenalkan semua orang.
notes.zh: 你的团队现在会在头两周邀请新员工一起吃午饭，并介绍每位同事。
